visual_description: A mid‑30s businessperson sits at a tidy office desk near a window, the soft afternoon light spilling onto the surface. In front of them lies an official‑looking notice on white paper, its top corner marked by a bold red circle that draws the eye to the date of issuance. To the right of the notice, an open wall calendar hangs on the wall; several recent days are lightly crossed out, while the current month’s page is clearly visible, emphasizing the passage of time. A simple analog wall clock behind the calendar shows the hands near the middle of the hour, underscoring the urgency of the deadline. The person’s hand rests on a pen, poised as they compare the highlighted date on the notice with the calendar, their expression focused. The composition is a medium shot, centered on the desk scene, with shallow depth of field that keeps the notice, calendar, and clock sharp while the background office elements fade softly. The lighting is natural, warm, and even, casting gentle shadows that highlight the paper and calendar without any glare.
